Save your app preferences (appearance, reading, notifications, privacy, language) and your account setup to a file, or restore them from one. Passwords are never included, so imported accounts need to be signed in again.

Other mail apps recognise your signature by this “-- ” line and can hide it when quoting your message; without it they no longer can, and the signature field then holds exactly what is sent.
Show who it\'s from and the subject.
Show who it\'s from, not the subject.
Watch every account for new mail, not just the current one. Uses more battery and connections.
During this window, new mail still arrives but without sound, vibration, or a heads-up.

No rules yet. Add one to filter incoming mail on the server.

Require your fingerprint, face, or screen PIN to open Sterna Mail.

No senders are set to always show images yet.
Remove trackers (utm_*, fbclid, gclid…) from links before opening them, so senders can\'t tell when you click.
Show the destination and ask before opening a link from a message.
Autocomplete recipients from this device\'s contacts while you type. Sterna Mail reads them on-device only, never uploads them. When off, it still suggests people you\'ve recently emailed.
Clearing the cache removes downloaded messages and attachments from this device. Your accounts stay signed in, and mail re-downloads when you open it.
Removes cached messages and attachments from this device. Accounts stay signed in.
Show notifications for new mail in this account.
API token (leave blank to keep current)

Identities are the \"from\" you send as: a name, address and signature. They have no password (your account login handles that). Your server decides which addresses it will actually send from. The default one is pre-selected when composing.
Each account keeps at least one identity.
Required. Blank identities are discarded when you save.
Your server may reject sending from this address.
Plain text, added to the message body when you write — edit or remove it there like any other text.
An HTML version is saved; it is sent as is if you don\'t change the signature in the message.

Sterna uses the OpenKeychain app to manage keys and encrypt messages. Install it to enable OpenPGP.
